<tr><th class="th"><div>Mar. 31, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_InvestmentCompanyAbstract', window );"><strong>Investment Company [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Net Assets</a></td>
<td class="text"><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-36pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">5.&#160;Net Assets</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">BXHF intends to offer three classes, or series of classes of limited partnership Units: Class&#160;I, Class&#160;S and Class&#160;D Units and may offer additional classes, or series of classes of Units in the future. BXHF, at the discretion of the General Partner, expects to have the authority to issue an unlimited number of Units of each class, or series of a class. The purchase price per Unit of each class, or series of a class,&#160;is equal to the NAV per Unit for such class, or series of a class,&#160;as of the last calendar day of the immediately preceding month. Until BXHF has determined its first NAV, the subscription price for Units will be $25.00 per Unit plus applicable subscription fees.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">NAV for each Unit class,&#160;or series of a class, will first be determined as of the end of the first full month after BXHF has accepted third-party investors and commenced investment operations. Thereafter, the NAV for each class,&#160;or series of a class, of Units will be calculated monthly by the Sponsor. The NAV will be based on the&#160;month-end&#160;values of investments, the addition of the value of any other assets such as cash, and the deduction of any liabilities, including the accrual and allocation of the Management Fee, Administration Fee and the Performance Participation Allocation and the deduction of expenses attributable to certain classes or series of classes, of Units, such as applicable Servicing Fees.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Certain financial intermediaries through which a unitholder is placed in BXHF may charge the unitholder upfront selling commissions, placement fees, subscription fees or similar fees (&#8220;Subscription Fees&#8221;) of up to (a)&#160;3.5% of NAV on Class&#160;S Units and (b) 1.5% of NAV on Class&#160;D Units sold in the offering. These Subscription Fees are paid by the unitholder outside of its investment in BXHF and not reflected in BXHF&#8217;s net asset value.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">On December&#160;17, 2025, the General Partner made an initial capital contribution of $100,000 in exchange for limited partner interests in BXHF. As of March&#160;31, 2026, the General Partner was BXHF&#8217;s only interest holder.</span></div><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
